turns.customer: My dog has an itchy rash. How much Benadryl can I give her before she boards? She's 40 lbs.
blocks:
I wouldn’t give Clover Benadryl without checking with her veterinarian first. An itchy rash can have different causes, and the right medication and dose depend on more than her 40-pound weight. Veterinary references list dosing, but ASPCA advises giving antihistamines to pets only under veterinary direction. ([aspca.org](https://www.aspca.org/news/can-human-allergy-medication-be-harmful-pets-our-experts-explain?utm_source=openai))

Call her vet and describe the rash before boarding; ask whether she needs to be examined and whether to give any medication. If she has facial or muzzle swelling, trouble breathing, repeated vomiting, weakness, or collapse, seek emergency veterinary care now.

Happy Tails’ published policy allows oral or topical medication when it’s provided in its container with clear written directions; it does not allow injections. ([merckvetmanual.com](https://www.merckvetmanual.com/integumentary-system/urticaria/urticaria-hives-wheals-in-animals?query=diphenhydramine+dose+dog&utm_source=openai))
